export function loadAppData() {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem('arSmartTourismData');
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(getDefaultState()));
    return getDefaultState();
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
    return {
      products: parsed.products || defaultProducts,
      hotels: parsed.hotels || defaultHotels,
      taxis: parsed.taxis || defaultTaxis,
      inquiries: parsed.inquiries || defaultInquiries,
      tourismSpots: [...(parsed.tourismSpots || []), ...allDefaultTourismSpots.filter(defaultSpot => !(parsed.tourismSpots || []).some(spot => spot.name === defaultSpot.name && spot.taluk === defaultSpot.taluk))],
      businesses: parsed.businesses || defaultBusinesses,
      orders: parsed.orders || defaultOrders,
      forms: parsed.forms || defaultForms
    };
  } catch (error) {
    localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(getDefaultState()));
    return getDefaultState();
  }
}
export function saveAppData(data) {
  localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(data));
  return data;
}
export function addInquiryEntry({
  userEmail,
  subject,
  type = 'general',
  message
}) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const entry = {
    id: Date.now(),
    userEmail: userEmail || 'guest@example.com',
    subject: subject || 'General Inquiry',
    type,
    message: message || '',
    status: 'Pending',
    reply: '',
    replyAt: ''
  };
  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    inquiries: [entry, ...data.inquiries]
  };
  saveAppData(nextData);
  return entry;
}

  saveAppData(nextData);
  return order;
}
export function addProduct(product) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const nextProduct = {
    id: `product-${Date.now()}`,
    name: product.name.trim(),
    category: product.category || 'General',
    price: Number(product.price || 0),
    mrp: Number(product.mrp || product.price || 0),
    rating: 0,
    reviews: 0,
    image: product.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1542838132-92c53300491e?w=500',
    description: product.description || 'Nilgiris local product',
    tribe: product.tribe || 'Nilgiris Artisan',
    inStock: product.inStock !== false
  };
  saveAppData({
    ...data,
    products: [nextProduct, ...data.products]
  });
  return nextProduct;
}
export function addUserForm({
  targetEmail,
  title,
  description,
  questions,
  createdBy
}) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const form = {
    id: `form-${Date.now()}`,
    targetEmail: targetEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
    title: title.trim(),
    description: description || '',
    questions: questions.map(question => ({
      id: `question-${Date.now()}-${question.id}`,
      text: question.text,
      answer: ''
    })),
    status: 'Unread',
    response: '',
    createdBy: createdBy || ADMIN_EMAIL,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    answeredAt: ''
  };
  saveAppData({
    ...data,
    forms: [form, ...(data.forms || [])]
  });
  return form;
}
export function answerUserForm(formId, answers, userEmail) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const response = answers.map(answer => `${answer.question}: ${answer.answer || '(No answer)'}`).join('\n');
  const nextForms = (data.forms || []).map(form => form.id === formId ? {
    ...form,
    status: 'Answered',
    response,
    answeredAt: new Date().toISOString()
  } : form);
  const form = nextForms.find(item => item.id === formId);
  const inquiry = form ? {
    id: Date.now() + 1,
    userEmail: userEmail || form.targetEmail,
    subject: `Form response: ${form.title}`,
    type: 'form',
    message: response,
    status: 'Pending',
    reply: '',
    replyAt: ''
  } : null;
  saveAppData({
    ...data,
    forms: nextForms,
    inquiries: inquiry ? [inquiry, ...data.inquiries] : data.inquiries
  });
  return form;
}
export function addTourismPlace(place) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    tourismSpots: [{
      id: Date.now(),
      name: place.name,
      district: place.district,
      taluk: place.taluk,
      type: place.type,
      rush: place.rush,
      nearby: (place.nearby || '').split(',').map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      description: place.description
    }, ...data.tourismSpots]
  };
  saveAppData(nextData);
  return nextData.tourismSpots[0];
}
export function addBusinessEntry(business) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    businesses: [{
      id: Date.now(),
      type: business.type,
      name: business.name,
      district: business.district,
      taluk: business.taluk,
      category: business.category,
      status: business.status,
      contact: business.contact
    }, ...data.businesses]
  };
  saveAppData(nextData);
  return nextData.businesses[0];
}
export function replyToInquiry(inquiryId, replyText, status = 'Replied') {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const trimmedReply = (replyText || '').trim();
  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    inquiries: data.inquiries.map(inquiry => inquiry.id === inquiryId ? {
      ...inquiry,
      status,
      reply: trimmedReply,
      replyAt: trimmedReply ? new Date().toISOString() : inquiry.replyAt
    } : inquiry)
  };
  saveAppData(nextData);
  return nextData.inquiries.find(inquiry => inquiry.id === inquiryId) || null;
}
export function getAdminEmail() {
  return ADMIN_EMAIL;
}

export const ADMIN_EMAIL = ADMIN_EMAIL_VALUE;

export function loadAppData() {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem('arSmartTourismData');
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(getDefaultState()));
    return getDefaultState();
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
    return {
      products: parsed.products || defaultProducts,
      hotels: parsed.hotels || defaultHotels,
      taxis: parsed.taxis || defaultTaxis,
      inquiries: parsed.inquiries || defaultInquiries,
      tourismSpots: [
        ...(parsed.tourismSpots || []),
        ...allDefaultTourismSpots.filter((defaultSpot) => !(parsed.tourismSpots || []).some((spot) => spot.name === defaultSpot.name && spot.taluk === defaultSpot.taluk))
      ],
      businesses: parsed.businesses || defaultBusinesses,
      orders: parsed.orders || defaultOrders,
      forms: parsed.forms || defaultForms
    };
  } catch (error) {
    localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(getDefaultState()));
    return getDefaultState();
  }
}

export function saveAppData(data) {
  localStorage.setItem('arSmartTourismData', JSON.stringify(data));
  return data;
}

export function addInquiryEntry({ userEmail, subject, type = 'general', message }) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const entry = {
    id: Date.now(),
    userEmail: userEmail || 'guest@example.com',
    subject: subject || 'General Inquiry',
    type,
    message: message || '',
    status: 'Pending',
    reply: '',
    replyAt: ''
  };

  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    inquiries: [entry, ...data.inquiries]
  };

  saveAppData(nextData);
  return entry;
}

export function addOrder({ userEmail, items, address, paymentMethod, total }) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const billNumber = `BILL-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
  const order = {
    id: Date.now(),
    userEmail: userEmail || 'guest@example.com',
    items: items || [],
    address: address || '',
    paymentMethod: paymentMethod || 'UPI',
    total: Number(total || 0),
    billNumber,
    status: 'Confirmed',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    orders: [order, ...data.orders],
    inquiries: [
      {
        id: Date.now() + 1,
        userEmail: userEmail || 'guest@example.com',
        subject: 'Order payment confirmation',
        type: 'product',
        message: `Order ${billNumber} placed for ${items?.length || 0} item(s). Payment method: ${paymentMethod}. Address: ${address}.`,
        status: 'Pending',
        reply: '',
        replyAt: ''
      },
      ...data.inquiries
    ]
  };

  saveAppData(nextData);
  return order;
}

export function addProduct(product) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const nextProduct = {
    id: `product-${Date.now()}`,
    name: product.name.trim(),
    category: product.category || 'General',
    price: Number(product.price || 0),
    mrp: Number(product.mrp || product.price || 0),
    rating: 0,
    reviews: 0,
    image: product.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1542838132-92c53300491e?w=500',
    description: product.description || 'Nilgiris local product',
    tribe: product.tribe || 'Nilgiris Artisan',
    inStock: product.inStock !== false
  };

  saveAppData({ ...data, products: [nextProduct, ...data.products] });
  return nextProduct;
}

export function addUserForm({ targetEmail, title, description, questions, createdBy }) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const form = {
    id: `form-${Date.now()}`,
    targetEmail: targetEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
    title: title.trim(),
    description: description || '',
    questions: questions.map((question) => ({ id: `question-${Date.now()}-${question.id}`, text: question.text, answer: '' })),
    status: 'Unread',
    response: '',
    createdBy: createdBy || ADMIN_EMAIL,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    answeredAt: ''
  };

  saveAppData({ ...data, forms: [form, ...(data.forms || [])] });
  return form;
}

export function answerUserForm(formId, answers, userEmail) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const response = answers.map((answer) => `${answer.question}: ${answer.answer || '(No answer)'}`).join('\n');
  const nextForms = (data.forms || []).map((form) =>
    form.id === formId
      ? { ...form, status: 'Answered', response, answeredAt: new Date().toISOString() }
      : form
  );
  const form = nextForms.find((item) => item.id === formId);
  const inquiry = form ? {
    id: Date.now() + 1,
    userEmail: userEmail || form.targetEmail,
    subject: `Form response: ${form.title}`,
    type: 'form',
    message: response,
    status: 'Pending',
    reply: '',
    replyAt: ''
  } : null;

  saveAppData({
    ...data,
    forms: nextForms,
    inquiries: inquiry ? [inquiry, ...data.inquiries] : data.inquiries
  });
  return form;
}

export function addTourismPlace(place) {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    tourismSpots: [
      {
        id: Date.now(),
        name: place.name,
        district: place.district,
        taluk: place.taluk,
        type: place.type,
        rush: place.rush,
        nearby: (place.nearby || '').split(',').map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        description: place.description
      },
      ...data.tourismSpots
    ]
  };

  saveAppData(nextData);
  return nextData.tourismSpots[0];
}

export function replyToInquiry(inquiryId, replyText, status = 'Replied') {
  const data = loadAppData();
  const trimmedReply = (replyText || '').trim();

  const nextData = {
    ...data,
    inquiries: data.inquiries.map((inquiry) =>
      inquiry.id === inquiryId
        ? {
            ...inquiry,
            status,
            reply: trimmedReply,
            replyAt: trimmedReply ? new Date().toISOString() : inquiry.replyAt
          }
        : inquiry
    )
  };

  saveAppData(nextData);
  return nextData.inquiries.find((inquiry) => inquiry.id === inquiryId) || null;
}
